data.narrative:
Dhruva Space is a Series B-stage space and aerospace company that has raised ₹27 crore to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 4 private peers in the same sector and stage cohort—Sierra Space ($8.0B, Series C), Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B, Series B), Aalyria ($1.3B, Series B), and Skyryse ($1.1B, Series C)—alongside a broader public comp set of 5 traded Space & Aerospace firms (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) with a median P/S multiple of 27.4x.

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy base ($27 crore) and applying a typical 1.9x Series B step-up multiplier, implies a valuation of $51 crore. Peer-median anchoring across the four same-sector comparables yields $1.6B, with a range spanning $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp P/S anchoring cannot be applied without disclosed revenue figures, which private companies typically do not publish.

The triangulated analysis across both applicable methods supports a valuation range of $44 crore (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $825 million. This wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around revenue scale and unit economics relative to the private peer set. The stage-progression method produces a substantially lower result than peer medians, suggesting either meaningful revenue or margin-accretion expectations embedded in recent comparable financings, or structural stage discounting effects. Further diligence on Dhruva's revenue run rate and path to next-stage capital requirements would be critical to narrowing this range.
